info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Financial Settlement Reviews API
info.description: The Financial Settlement Reviews API enables users to submit reviews and feedback related to card financial settlements within the banking domain. This API allows businesses to enhance their service quality by collecting insights from users regarding their settlement experiences. Typical consumers include financial institutions, payment processors, and merchant services. By leveraging this API, organizations can analyze reviews to identify trends, improve user satisfaction, and enhance operational performance.
